purpose: causal/mechanistic decomposition of the V2 Mahalanobis-FAIL / EDL-PASS specificity contradiction into (1) generic Evidence-presence/distribution bias, (2) representation/Evidence-processing effects, (3) final novelty-readout effects. NOT detector selection; V2 decision METHOD_DEPENDENT_REVIEW NOT reopened.

real_reproduces_validation.rule: REAL-condition Mahalanobis best-legal gains == persisted V2 validation same_sample values within 1e-6 (all 3 rotations x RK/TU)
real_reproduces_validation.note: after float64 promotion the recomputed means match the persisted float64 npz-derived audit values to <1e-8; the residual 3.4e-6 was float32-vs-float64 subtraction noise eliminated by the logged bugfix

edl_sanity.rule: alpha >= 1 everywhere; loss decreases over training steps (per rotation, same-repr head)

shuffled_preserves_marginals.rule: shuffled T/R block mean/std == original within 1e-9, RK and TU separately

null_present_masks.rule: NULL-PRESENT T/R blocks all-zero; availability masks present as in state

bugfix_log.what: frozen primaries were not set to model.eval() before forward passes (dropout active corrupts the frozen representation); fixed to match the validated primary_replay convention exactly (model.eval() after load)
Mahalanobis scores and EDL alpha were float32 (torch output); promoted to float64 before gain subtraction to match the persisted float64 audit convention (validated npz saves astype(float64))
bootstrap_pooled real_minus_control_gap loop lacked the missing-condition guard used for single-condition bootstraps (same-repr / reverse); added guard

chain_audit.conclusion: the two chains differ exhaustively in (1) final readout function (Mahalanobis min-distance geometry vs Dirichlet belief), (2) training objective (CE + 0.10*SupCon vs Type-II ML + KL lambda=0.1), (3) therefore the representation h differs. Everything upstream (features, transforms, block stacks, masks, architecture, exposure schedule) is identical. The contradiction is therefore NOT a priori a pure readout effect; the diagnostic isolates the three factors empirically.

definition.REAL: true legal T/R Evidence, deployed masks (identity check vs V2 validation)
definition.NULL_PRESENT: availability mask present; T/R Evidence block = all-zero neutral vector in the frozen log1p transform space
definition.SHUFFLED: deterministic permutation of T/R blocks within rotation/seed/eval population/block type; RK and TU shuffled separately; offline mechanism control only (not a deployable policy)

pooled_bootstrap.method: 1000 rotation-stratified sample replicates, seeded (162000+500), paired within condition/population; 2.5/97.5 percentile 95% CIs; pooled = sample-pooled over the RK (5567) / TU (24000) rows of the three rotations

key_question.generic_presence_shift: NULL-PRESENT produces NEGATIVE gains for both RK and TU (pooled -40.1 / -19.8): adding an empty Evidence block moves samples AWAY from Known in Mahalanobis distance. Mask presence alone does NOT reproduce any of the REAL Knownward movement (ratios -0.556 / -0.138).
key_question.generic_distribution_shift: SHUFFLED reproduces 89.3% (CI [87.7, 91.0]) of the REAL RK movement and 101.5% (CI [100.9, 102.2]) of the REAL TU movement: unrelated Evidence produces essentially all of the generic Knownward magnitude.
key_question.specificity_structure: The REAL specificity gap (-71.78) is LESS negative (better RK/TU separation) than the SHUFFLED gap (-81.64): paired REAL - SHUFFLED = +9.86, CI [8.36, 11.35]. A modest content-specific component exists; the NULL comparison does not support the full content-signal rule (REAL - NULL = -51.5, CI negative) because NULL-PRESENT reverses direction.

same_representation_test.design: same frozen primary representation h (persisted model.pt, central seed); readout A = frozen Mahalanobis per-state geometry; readout B = one fixed Dirichlet head trained on frozen h only (trunk fully frozen + eval mode; exact V2 EDL semantics: Type-II ML + KL 0.1, AdamW 3e-4/1e-4, 20-epoch cap, patience 3, Known-only FIT/EARLY_STOP/calibration; rng offset 300; seed 20260817). No representation update, no tuning.
same_representation_test.conclusion: with representation AND Evidence processing held exactly fixed, the Mahalanobis-negative / EDL-positive specificity contradiction survives in all three rotations (rule 1 support: READOUT_DOMINANT).

reverse_crosscheck.design: B_EDL retrained with the exact frozen V2 recipe (seed 20260817, rng offset 200, identical to the validation replay); frozen EDL trunk representation h_EDL; per-state Mahalanobis geometry fitted on h_EDL TRAIN FIT Known rows; gains/gaps on the same RK/TU rows. No encoder retraining, no redesign.
reverse_crosscheck.conclusion: the Mahalanobis gap remains negative in all three rotations on the EDL-trained representation; the sign pattern follows the READOUT, not the representation (the magnitude shrinks from -71.78 to -58.86, so representation choice matters quantitatively, not sign-wise). Rule 2 (REPRESENTATION_OR_PROCESSING_DOMINANT) NOT supported.

edl_mechanism_diagnostics.design: retrained B_EDL chain; per row at state B vs the row's own best-legal state; deltas after - before. S = sum(alpha) (Dirichlet strength), u = K/S (K=6), p_top = max(alpha)/S, p_2nd, top-1 identity stability.
edl_mechanism_diagnostics.conclusion: For RK, Evidence concentrates belief: total Evidence S rises (dS +41/+84/+36) and top-class concentration rises (dp_top +0.24/+0.28/+0.20) with uncertainty falling (du -0.14/-0.22/-0.14) — the EDL PASS structure is an Evidence-induced concentration on a single Known class. For TU the effects are smaller or absent (Cred +0.07, Web -0.03) EXCEPT Recon TU (dS +217, dp_top +0.08, stability 0.91), where TU also accumulates Evidence and stays stably confident. Top-1 identity stability is materially lower for RK on Recon (0.304), i.e., RK rows jump between classes under Evidence.

support.READOUT_DOMINANT: same frozen h shows Mahalanobis gap negative AND EDL-head gap positive in 3/3 rotations (pooled EDL-head gap +0.0606, CI [0.0562, 0.0645]); representation and Evidence processing held exactly fixed
support.GENERIC_EVIDENCE_DISTRIBUTION_BIAS: pooled SHUFFLED_TO_REAL_RK = 0.893 (CI [0.877, 0.910]), SHUFFLED_TO_REAL_TU = 1.015 (CI [1.009, 1.022]); unrelated Evidence reproduces >= 89% of the REAL Knownward magnitude
support.GENERIC_EVIDENCE_PRESENCE_BIAS: NOT supported: NULL_TO_REAL ratios are negative (-0.556 / -0.138); mask presence alone moves samples away from Known
support.RECOVERY_SPECIFIC_CONTENT_SIGNAL: PARTIAL, not supported: REAL separates RK from TU better than SHUFFLED (paired +9.86, CI [8.36, 11.35]) but the NULL comparison fails (REAL - NULL = -51.5, CI negative)
support.REPRESENTATION_OR_PROCESSING_DOMINANT: NOT supported: Mahalanobis on the EDL-trained representation stays negative 3/3 (pooled -58.86, CI [-64.76, -53.32])

interpretation.consequence_rule_statement: The preregistered consequence ('if only that EDL is a generally stronger detector... the recovery-aware novelty innovation hypothesis is weakened') does NOT apply: the fixed-representation contradiction IS reproduced (rule 1), so EDL's PASS is a readout-level phenomenon on identical representations, not a generally-stronger-detector artifact. However, the distribution control shows ~90-100% of the REAL Knownward movement is reproduced by unrelated Evidence, so the generic movement is dominated by distribution-level shift; only a modest content-specific separation component (REAL vs SHUFFLED +9.9) is attributable to target-matched content. The recovery-aware hypothesis is neither confirmed nor weakened at the representation level; it is unresolved at the readout level.

acceptance.REVERSE_CROSSCHECK: COMPLETED (Mahalanobis gap negative 3/3 on EDL-trained representation)
acceptance.CONTENT_SPECIFIC_SEPARATION: PARTIAL (REAL vs SHUFFLED +9.86 CI>0; REAL vs NULL fails)
acceptance.EDL_GENERALLY_STRONGER_ALONE: FALSE (fixed-representation contradiction reproduced; consequence rule not triggered)
